ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Apr-22-2004 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name.
Commissioner Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Tina Paxton.
Patricia Anne Siehl, Esq. for Petitioners: Bora Peang and Mohamed Mused Alhaj, present with the minor: Brian Peang, were sworn and examined.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for change of the MINOR'S name to: Brian Mohamed Alhaj.
Decree signed in open court.
